providers.note: Gemini now has a shared, cross-skill Bedrock-mapping guide at skills/shared/ai/ai-gemini-to-bedrock.md (vendored into gcp-to-aws and azure-to-aws), the same bar anthropic's and openai's guides meet, so this provider clears status: supported. The source-cloud-scoped copy under skills/gcp-to-aws/references/design-refs/ai-gemini-to-bedrock.md is retained as that skill's adapter-local guide; moving its runtime routing onto the shared guide is deferred to the extraction stages (issue #389 stages 3a-3e). supported reflects documentation coverage only, not an implemented adapter: implemented_adapter stays null.

gateways.note: OpenRouter now has a shared, cross-skill gateway-routing guide at skills/shared/ai/ai-openrouter-to-bedrock.md (vendored into gcp-to-aws and azure-to-aws) that documents how an OpenRouter-fronted upstream model maps onto a Bedrock target and defers per-model selection to the per-provider guides. That is the mapping-guide bar this catalog uses for supported, so this entry moves from unknown to supported. This is still documentation coverage only, not code: discover-openrouter-api.md already detects OpenRouter usage and BYOK-vs-credits attribution per upstream model at runtime, but route stays null because an implemented routing adapter is a separate, stricter bar tracked by route and no such adapter is wired up yet.
